corpus.author_wrote_disclosure: Every gold set in this corpus was written by the ARC-0029 test-plan author, who also wrote the a4-index/v1 trigger lists and the lexical reference router. Recall numbers are therefore an internal consistency check of the router against author labels, not an independent generalization claim. A held-out slice is paired: those tasks were labelled after the index bytes were frozen and triggers were not edited afterward, but the labels are still author-written.

corpus.label_provenance: author-written-2026-08-24-ARC-0029; no live transcript harvest; TEST-REGISTRY.json absent on this tree

evidence.claim: Labelled corpus is enumerated with size, gold sets, slice, and label provenance.
Recall is computed over an author-written corpus and disclosed as such, paired with a held-out slice labelled after index freeze.
Removing cap.secrets-scan drops recall hits by exactly the expected amount.
Worst-case flooding task stays under session_budget_tokens; unbounded contrast exceeds it.
command-center/phase3/A4/DESIGN.json was read from this worktree as the index format source.

index_contract.derived_from: ARC-0024 catalog contract (index all, materialize selected, hard session budget, idle resident-set = index summaries). command-center/phase3/A4/DESIGN.json is absent on this tree; this index is test-owned, not an ADV rebuild of A4 DESIGN.
index_contract.note: Tests pin this test-owned index contract from the ARC-0024 catalog question. DESIGN.json is absent; this unit does not rebuild A4 DESIGN.
resident_when_idle: a4-index/v1 summaries only; capability bodies not loaded

mutation_controls.mutation: Delete cap.secrets-scan from a4-index/v1 while leaving corpus gold labels unchanged

negative_controls.description: At least one corpus task has no correct capability; fallback must fire on those tasks and stay silent on a recall task whose declaration files would still be syntactically valid.
An always-top-3 stub scored by gold-frequency must stay below the exact-match floor so the corpus is not satisfied by popularity bias.

question: Specify the router regression suite that proves the gateway selects relevant capabilities WITHOUT flooding context: the selection-recall test over a labelled task corpus, the context-budget ceiling test, the no-capability-fits fallback test, and the explanation test (why a capability was selected) - plus the mutation control proving recall goes red when an installed capability is removed from the index.

observations.method: route each kind=recall task; count |gold ∩ selected| against author-written gold
observations.name: recall_micro_hits

observations.method: same router on slice=held_out after index freeze
observations.name: held_out_recall_hits

observations.method: delete cap.secrets-scan from index; recompute recall hits
observations.name: mutation_observed_drop

reviewer.method: Probe2 re-runs the remove-cap mutation on live router+corpus, then applies a declared-vs-realized token undercount that the flooding control does not observe.

mutation_suite_would_not_catch.mutation: Set realized_tokens = 20 * context_tokens on every capability while leaving the index context_tokens field unchanged.
mutation_suite_would_not_catch.why_green: Flooding control sums declared context_tokens, not realized payload size; mutant flooding stays PASS (caught_by_suite=False, still_green=True).
mutation_suite_would_not_catch.would_need: A realized-token meter on the injected payload (IMP-0392 class).

does_not_claim: independent non-author labels or live transcript harvest
scope.proof_surface: Lexical reference router + labelled fixture corpus under command-center/p2-wave/probes/ARC-0029/

tests.name: Selection recall over the labelled task corpus (primary + held-out)
tests.observable: micro-recall hits/total_gold on kind=recall tasks, including the held-out slice; not a file-existence check

tests.name: Context-budget ceiling on the worst-case flooding control task
tests.observable: sum of selected context_tokens and selected set size versus session_budget_tokens and max_selected; unbounded contrast must exceed

tests.name: No-capability-fits fallback on anti-tautology tasks
tests.observable: verdict NO-CAPABILITY-FITS and empty selected set on gold=[] tasks; SELECTED on a recall control (both-states)

tests.name: Explanation reconstructs the selected set and names matching triggers
tests.observable: reconstruct_selected(explanation) == live selected ids and every selected row carries matched_triggers

tests.name: Mutation control: remove one indexed capability; recall drops by the expected hits
